resume_contract.explanation: R27 now supplies the latest verified published partial return. Preserve its completed receipts and the earlier scientific work. Resolve fresh return pointers and any newer durable journals again at launch, refresh only expired price evidence, and admit unfinished eligible work after the cost guard has a verified rate. Do not restart the campaign from an older return.
resume_contract.headline: A verified partial return is the new continuation point.
steps: Resolve the latest verified return and newer durable owner journals again at launch; preserve the distinction between an archive and an unpublished checkpoint.
Authenticate saved fit and prediction receipts against the same inputs, recipe, temporal split and population. Reuse completed scientific work; changed reporting weights alone must not refit it.
Recover completed worker outputs whose parent publication failed. A wrapper or reporting failure must not discard an already completed estimator.
Keep paid source captures and normalized partitions keyed by their real request and content identities. Fetch actual gaps, not the entire history again.
Checkpoint after bounded tasks, stop new admission when interrupted, drain admitted work safely, and publish a verified partial return only after integrity checks.

science_contract.note: Men and women retain independent populations and champion registries. Selection uses annual 2024–25 and 2025–26 validation metrics, with 50/50 primary and the four declared sensitivity ratios. Changing these ratios does not change training weights or predictions. Completed 2026–27 games remain a frozen test report, with zero selection weight. Earlier test exposure remains disclosed; full official populations and a new qualified champion are still incomplete.

source_coverage.limits: The retained report covers 106 bookmakers and 44,520 source/season/market/horizon cells; 1,384 cells were nonzero and no bookmaker had complete coverage. Missing histories remain gaps. Source availability, historical issue-time qualification, model-ready rows and full game populations are different claims.
source_coverage.note: The preserved R23 source stage recorded 345 successful HTTP responses: 257 Odds API responses, 50 ESPN and 38 NCAA official. Its bounded acquisition plan recorded 256 of 2,680 captures, with 2,424 pending. These are dated progress counters, not retrievals performed by this dashboard. The newer recovered R25 scoreboard stage reached 21 of 34 units before a source-capture persistence stop; it did not complete a source refresh. R26 records 168 verified storage-cache reads totaling 1,862,389,518 bytes and 19 fresh full object reads totaling 112,366,700 bytes. These are storage I/O observations, not additional provider requests or fitted models. R27 stopped before a source refresh. Its returned evidence does not contain the same storage-read report, so current cache and fresh-read measurements remain unknown; the earlier R26 numbers are not copied forward.

throughput.next_run_rule: Target 12 useful scientific workers and admit up to 24 only with verified shared CPU and memory headroom. The explicit worker ceiling must hold. Measure preparation, fit-worker CPU, ready depth, completions and starvation separately; require 75% of admitted capacity over 180 seconds when enough eligible work exists.
